from glom import Fill, Assign, assign, Coalesce, Auto, Check, Inspect, Iter, Let, Invoke, ROOT
import glom.constants as constants

# Test Fill repr
f = Fill('a', default=0)
print('Fill repr:', repr(f))

# Test Assign repr  
a = Assign(['x'], 'y')
print('Assign repr:', repr(a))

# Test Coalesce repr
c = Coalesce('a', 'b')
print('Coalesce repr:', repr(c))

# Test Auto repr
print('Auto repr:', repr(Auto()))

# Test Check repr
ck = Check(type=int)
print('Check repr:', repr(ck))

# Test Iter repr
i = Iter()
print('Iter repr:', repr(i))

# Test Let repr
l = Let({'a': 1})
print('Let repr:', repr(l))

# Test Invoke repr
v = Invoke(sum, 1, 2)
print('Invoke repr:', repr(v))

# Test ROOT
print('ROOT:', repr(ROOT))

# Test constants module
print('constants.SKIP:', constants.SKIP)
print('constants.STOP:', constants.STOP)
print('constants.OMIT:', constants.OMIT)
print('constants.RAISE:', constants.RAISE)
"
